activities.title: REST API Fundamentals
activities.description: Master HTTP verbs, status codes, request/response cycle, JSON payloads, and basic authentication using FastAPI/Express.

activities.title: Build a REST API Project
activities.description: Construct a complete RESTful service with CRUD operations, JWT auth, database persistence (SQLAlchemy), and Swagger docs.

activities.title: Automated Testing Fundamentals
activities.description: Learn unit testing principles, test assertions, mocks, fixtures, and parameterized testing using pytest/Jest.

activities.title: Testing Project Integration
activities.description: Write comprehensive unit and integration test suites achieving >80% code coverage on your REST API project.

activities.title: Docker Fundamentals
activities.description: Learn Docker architecture, container lifecycles, writing multi-stage Dockerfiles, and managing images.

activities.title: Deploy a Containerized Application
activities.description: Dockerize the full REST API service with Docker Compose (API + PostgreSQL + Redis) and deploy on cloud VM.

activities.title: Data Structures & Algorithm Mastery
activities.description: Solve intermediate algorithmic challenges covering binary trees, graphs, dynamic programming, and hash tables.

activities.title: Python Data Manipulation with Pandas & NumPy
activities.description: Vectorized computations, handling missing values, data grouping, merging, and reshaping messy datasets.

activities.title: Exploratory Data Analysis & Visualization
activities.description: Conduct deep statistical EDA and build interactive dashboards using Matplotlib, Seaborn, and Plotly.

activities.title: Applied Statistical Analysis & Inference
activities.description: Probability distributions, hypothesis testing (t-tests, ANOVA, Chi-square), confidence intervals, and correlation analysis.

activities.title: Supervised & Unsupervised Machine Learning
activities.description: Regression, classification (KNN, Trees, Ensembles), clustering (K-Means), cross-validation, and metrics.

activities.title: End-to-End Predictive Machine Learning Project
activities.description: Develop, validate, hyperparameter-tune, and deploy a production ML model pipeline on real-world datasets.

activities.title: Linux Systems Administration & Hardening
activities.description: Linux permissions, PAM authentication, process isolation, SSH key configs, systemd services, and iptables firewalling.

activities.title: Network Protocols & Traffic Inspection
activities.description: Deep packet analysis with Wireshark, dissecting TCP 3-way handshakes, TLS negotiation, DNS poisoning, and ARP spoofing.

activities.title: Applied Cryptography Fundamentals
activities.description: Symmetric encryption (AES-GCM), asymmetric cryptosystems (RSA, ECC), digital signatures, PKI, and hashing (SHA-256).

activities.title: Vulnerability Assessment & Penetration Testing Lab
activities.description: Conduct simulated vulnerability scanning (Nmap, OpenVAS, Burp Suite) against intentionally vulnerable target labs.

activities.title: Cloud Computing Essentials (AWS / GCP)
activities.description: Core cloud architecture: compute instances (EC2/GCE), object storage (S3/GCS), virtual private clouds (VPC), and IAM policies.

activities.title: Continuous Integration & Deployment (CI/CD)
activities.description: Build multi-stage GitHub Actions workflows for linting, automated testing, container building, and deployment to staging.

activities.title: Infrastructure as Code with Terraform
activities.description: Declarative cloud provisioning: state management, providers, variables, outputs, and modular cloud architectures.

activities.title: User Research & Usability Testing Methods
activities.description: Conduct user interviews, synthesize personas, map customer journeys, and run qualitative usability evaluations.

activities.title: Advanced Figma Prototyping & Interactions
activities.description: Master auto-layout, interactive components, micro-interactions, responsive constraints, and clickable prototypes in Figma.

activities.title: Comprehensive Design System Case Study
activities.description: Create an atomic design system complete with design tokens (colors, typography, spacing), component states, and accessibility standards.
